sources.title: Getting Started with Edge AI on NVIDIA Jetson: LLMs, VLMs, and ...
sources.snippet: Which Jetson is Right for You? Use Jetson Orin Nano Super (8GB) if you're just getting started with local AI, running small LLMs or VLMs, or building early-stage robotics and edge prototypes. It's especially well-suited for hobbyist robotics and embedded projects where cost, simplicity, and compact size matter more than maximum model capacity.
